title_zh: 一签｜文字盲盒与像素签名
title_en: One Fortune | Notes to Draw and Keep
description_zh:
一签是一只随身文字盲盒。按下抽签，拆开一封未知的信：可能是一首古诗、一句冷幽默、一个荒诞脑洞，也可能是生活观察或一点安慰。喜欢哪一句，就连同像素风景收进16格签册，随时翻阅，也能选作自己的个人签名展示。

内置2,200张完整签文：1,980条原创短句与220条古诗词摘句，诗词显示作者和篇名。默认从全库随机抽取；想专门读某类内容，可在独立主题页选好并确认。同一轮不重复，回首页或重启恢复全库随机。安慰占签库20%、诗词占10%，其余带来更多关于日常、关系、审美与出走的不同说法。

封好的信轻轻晃动、拆开、揭晓，短小的音乐盒音效陪着这份期待；音量可调，也能静音。十个像素系列提供320款皮肤、1,920种外观，随机换风景，文字保持原样。收藏卡片可重新展示、换肤或移出，满额时由你确认替换。再抽保留签册和已留签名，重启继续展示。完全离线，无需配网或付费。签文用于阅读、表达和娱乐，不作未来预测。

封面为玩法示意；四张详情图为实际程序主机渲染与说明，非设备实拍。
description_en:
One Fortune is a pocket surprise box of words. Press to draw and open an unknown letter: a classical verse, a dry joke, a surreal idea, an everyday observation or a little reassurance. Keep a line and its pixel-art scenery in a 16-card album. Browse your favorites whenever you like, or choose one as your personal signature.

Discover 2,200 complete notes: 1,980 original lines and 220 classical Chinese poetry excerpts with author and work title. Draw randomly across the whole collection by default, or confirm one of eight themes on a separate selector. Notes do not repeat within a cycle. Returning home or restarting restores whole-bank draws. Reassurance makes up 20% of the collection and poetry 10%; the rest brings different perspectives on daily life, relationships, taste and small outings.

A sealed letter shakes, opens and reveals its words, accompanied by brief music-box sounds. Adjust the volume or mute them. Ten pixel-art collections offer 320 skins and 1,920 appearances to discover in shuffled order. Change the scenery while keeping the words. Display a favorite, change its artwork or remove it; replacing a card in a full album requires your confirmation. Drawing again keeps your album and signature, and restarting displays the signature again. Fully offline, with no Wi-Fi setup or payment. The interface and notes are Chinese, intended for reading, expression and entertainment rather than predictions.

The cover is a gameplay illustration. Four detail images use actual application host renders and explanatory graphics, not device photographs.
instructions_zh:
1. 开机即用，完全离线无需配网；黑屏按任意键唤醒。若显示签名，长按确定回首页。
2. 首页按确定随机抽签；等信封揭晓，确定可跳过。想按主题抽，上下打开主题页，选好后确定。
3. 结果页上再抽、下换肤、确定收藏并展示为签名，最多16张；满额先选旧签，再确认替换。
4. 首页长按确定或签名页短按确定打开签册；上下翻阅，确定整理，可展示、换肤或移出。长按确定逐层返回首页，继续抽签。
5. 卡片页长上调音量，上下调节、确定保存；长下开关音效。收藏、签名及声音设置重启保留。
instructions_en:
1. Turn on the device; it works offline with no Wi-Fi setup. Press any button once to wake a dark screen. If your signature appears, hold OK to return home.
2. Press OK on home for a random draw. Wait for the letter to reveal its words, or press OK to skip. For a specific theme, open the selector with UP/DOWN, choose a theme and confirm with OK.
3. On the result, UP draws again, DOWN changes the artwork, and OK collects the card and displays it as your signature. Keep up to 16 cards; when full, choose an old card and confirm its replacement.
4. Hold OK on home, or press OK on the signature, to open the album. Browse with UP/DOWN; OK opens actions to display, change artwork or remove a card. Hold OK to step back to home and continue drawing.
5. On a card, hold UP for volume, adjust with UP/DOWN and press OK to save; hold DOWN to toggle sound. Favorites, your signature and sound settings survive restarts.
changelog_zh:
• 新增16格签册，每张收藏保留签文和外观，可翻阅、换肤、移出，或选作当前签名。
• 首页长按确定、签名页短按确定进入签册；上下翻页、确定整理、长按确定逐层返回。满额替换和移出都需确认，默认取消。
• 加入轻柔翻页过渡、收藏书签印记和位置提示。兼容旧版存档，已有签名及外观会进入第一格；收藏或换肤保存失败时保留原状态，可重试。
• Mac模拟器同步支持签册操作、满额替换和重启恢复。
changelog_en:
• Adds a 16-card album. Each favorite keeps its words and artwork, with actions to browse, change artwork, remove it or display it as your signature.
• Hold OK on home or press OK on the signature to enter. UP/DOWN turns pages, OK opens actions, and holding OK steps back. Replacement when full and removal both require confirmation, with cancel selected by default.
• Adds gentle page transitions, a bookmark seal after collecting and position markers. Previous saves import the signature and artwork into the first slot. Failed collection or artwork saves retain the original state for retry.
• The Mac simulator supports the same album actions, full-capacity replacement and recovery after restarting.
